dishes.name: Labskaus
dishes.desc: Sailor's mash of corned beef, potatoes and beetroot topped with fried egg and rollmops. Hamburg's best-known harbour dish.

dishes.name: Franzbrötchen
dishes.desc: Cinnamon-sugar pastry rolled and flattened like a croissant, found in every Hamburg bakery.

dishes.name: Rundstück warm
dishes.desc: Warm roast pork in a crusty roll with gravy, a Hamburg lunchtime classic.

dishes.name: Hamburger Aalsuppe
dishes.desc: Sweet-sour soup with eel, vegetables, dried fruit and dumplings, a signature harbour-city recipe.

dishes.name: Pannfisch
dishes.desc: Pan-fried fish with mustard sauce and fried potatoes, a north German tavern classic of the harbour.
